prompt_fragment:
This asset is an icon. Use crisp, reduced shapes, bold edges, and high readability at very small sizes.
Keep the icon silhouette bold, crisp, and readable at 16px.
raw_description:
A stylized tome / book artifact marker. Flat app-icon geometry. A
simple closed book seen from the front — a flat rectangular cover in
a saturated palette color (deep red or deep navy), with a vertical
binding spine on the left side in a contrasting palette color, and a
small simple geometric emblem centered on the cover (a diamond, a
circle, or a cross) in a third palette color.
formatted_prompt: Flat app-icon illustration, centered on a plain off-white canvas with generous padding, bold vector geometry readable at 16px. A closed hardcover book seen straight-on: a tall rectangular cover in vivid red (#FF0000) with a narrow vertical binding spine on the left in bright blue (#0000FF), and a small bold diamond emblem centered on the cover in yellow (#FFFF00). All edges crisp and sharp, flat solid color fills, zero gradients or texture. Black (#000000) outlines define each shape with comic-book confidence. Clean modern UI icon register, Phosphor Fill style, every element a distinct saturated hue with strong color separation, fully legible as a map marker at any small size.
